findings.summary: Plain `git diff` cannot show how the new file differs from the archived one.
findings.evidence: docs/design/records-history.md is a new file on this branch (Glob found no match). `git diff` would show the whole file as added, not its differences from the archive. The demonstration then falls back to 'read ... against it', which is a by-eye comparison. Fix: Use a direct comparison such as `git diff archive/next4-2026-10-23 -- docs/design/records-history.md`, or `diff <(git show archive/next4-2026-10-23:docs/design/records-history.md) docs/design/records-history.md`. Expect only the D112→D111 lines and the listed branch-state adjustments.

findings.summary: docs/ontology.toml and docs/enforcement.md already exist on this branch, so a reference to them is not automatically a branch-state difference.
findings.evidence: Glob found docs/ontology.toml and docs/enforcement.md in the snapshot. docs/spec.toml is absent. The plan treats every hit on these names as a candidate for adjustment. Fix: Adjust a reference only when what it describes is untrue here: spec.toml, the spec job's D111, or content the spec job added to the two existing files. Leave references to the files that exist unchanged, and list each adjustment made.

findings.summary: The CHANGELOG comparison is by eye.
findings.evidence: The demonstration compares `git diff CHANGELOG.md` with the archived file by reading both. Fix: Extract the two archived bullets and diff them against the added lines, so that the D112→D111 change is the only difference shown.

summary: The plan fits the request and the accepted reading. It copies the three archived texts, takes only the records-history parts, renumbers D112 to D111, appends the decision after D110, and puts the two CHANGELOG entries under [Unreleased]. I checked its stated facts against the snapshot. docs/decisions.md's last heading is D110 at line 2553, and there is no D111 or D112. CHANGELOG.md has [Unreleased] at line 8, the Added bullets end at line 27, and '### Fixed' is at line 29. docs/design/records-history.md does not exist yet. One fact the plan does not record: docs/ontology.toml and docs/enforcement.md already exist on this branch. A reference to them in the archived text is not automatically state that differs, so it may not need adjusting. The demonstrations rely on the producer reading diffs by eye. That works, but a direct diff against the archive would make criteria 1 and 4 checkable mechanically. The findings below are minor and the plan can proceed.
